scientific_integrity: The asymptotic proof is analytic; numerical checks are supporting diagnostics only. The univariate product-survival asymptotic and the bivariate weak residual exponent are credited to earlier work.

title: Sharp simultaneous extremes and latent localization for shared-gamma products
